catalog.title: EMAIL CC RULES
catalog.desc: Admin: control who gets CC'd / added on outgoing auto-emails based on sender, agreement category (last 2 of the request number), and direction. Publishes fleet-wide.
catalog.action: if (window.eli && window.eli.dispatch) window.eli.dispatch('tile', 'app_admin_email_rules'); else if (typeof showAdminEmailRules === 'function') showAdminEmailRules(window.eli); else if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Email CC Rules not loaded.', 'error');
